NVIDIA (NVDA) vs Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): on the same formula, their operating margins are 49.7 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — NVDA: $215.9B · AMD: $34.6B
• Revenue growth — NVDA: +65.5% · AMD: +34.3%
• Operating margin — NVDA: 60.4% · AMD: 10.7%
• Net margin — NVDA: 55.6% · AMD: 12.5%
• Free cash flow margin — NVDA: 44.8% · AMD: 19.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — NVDA: 68.3% · AMD: 20.5%

Different fiscal years: NVDA Jan 25, 2026 · AMD Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
